description: Explore city experiences and build travel itineraries using catalog information from YourHolidayGPT. This submission uses a separate research-only MCP endpoint with four read-only tools: city discovery, experience search, product details and itinerary source data. It returns descriptions, durations, ratings and available travel conditions without checkout, purchase links, affiliate redirects, eSIM offers or owner access. Catalog information may be incomplete or outdated. Separately, our website operates affiliate travel referrals and direct eSIM sales; those commercial flows are not exposed by this submitted endpoint.

defaultPrompt: Find three experiences in Rome and compare their duration and available accessibility information.
